title: Ivo and the Inheritance
author: Juniper Halloran
blurb: Coral Quintana, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
